mapper.select: SELECT A.TECH,A.EQP_G,B.WAFER_QTY,B.WAFER_K FROM( SELECT 'Cap' TECH ,#{eqpg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}EQP_G FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'Request' TECH ,#{eqpg,jdbcType=VARCHAR} EQP_G FROM DUAL )A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT EQP_G,WAFER_QTY,WAFER_K,TECH FROM( SELECT EQP_G,CAP_WAFER WAFER_QTY,CAP_K WAFER_K ,'Cap' TECH FROM A1_MFG.OUTPUT_REVIEW_KEYIN_COMMENT WHERE SHIFT_MONTH=#{month,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION ALL SELECT EQP_G,REQ_WAFER WAFER_QTY,REQ_K WAFER_K ,'Request' TECH FROM A1_MFG.OUTPUT_REVIEW_KEYIN_COMMENT WHERE SHIFT_MONTH=#{month,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ))B ON A.TECH = B.TECH AND A.EQP_G = B.EQP_G
mapper.update: merge into A1_MFG.OUTPUT_REVIEW_KEYIN_COMMENT t using ( select #{EQP_G,jdbcType=VARCHAR} EQP_G,#{WAFER_QTY,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WAFER_QTY,#{WAFER_K,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WAFER_K ,#{UPD_USER,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPD_USER from dual )s on (t.EQP_G = s.EQP_G) when matched then update set t.CAP_WAFER = s.WAFER_QTY,t.CAP_K = s.WAFER_K,t.UPDATE_USER = s.UPD_USER,t.UPDATE_TIME = sysdate when not matched then insert (EQP_G,CAP_WAFER,CAP_K,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME) values (s.EQP_G,s.WAFER_QTY,s.WAFER_K,s.UPD_USER,sysdate)

merge into A1_MFG.OUTPUT_REVIEW_KEYIN_COMMENT t using ( select #{EQP_G,jdbcType=VARCHAR} EQP_G,#{WAFER_QTY,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WAFER_QTY,#{WAFER_K,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WAFER_K ,#{UPD_USER,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPD_USER from dual )s on (t.EQP_G = s.EQP_G) when matched then update set t.REQ_WAFER = s.WAFER_QTY,t.REQ_K = s.WAFER_K,t.UPDATE_USER = s.UPD_USER,t.UPDATE_TIME = sysdate when not matched then insert (EQP_G,REQ_WAFER,REQ_K,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME) values (s.EQP_G,s.WAFER_QTY,s.WAFER_K,s.UPD_USER,sysdate)

merge into A1_MFG.OUTPUT_REVIEW_KEYIN_COMMENT t using ( select #{EQP_G,jdbcType=VARCHAR} EQP_G, #{F_COMMENT,jdbcType=VARCHAR} F_COMMENT, #{F_COMMENT2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} F_COMMENT2 ,#{VERSION,jdbcType=VARCHAR} VERSION ,#{UPD_USER,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPD_USER from dual )s ON (t.EQP_G = s.EQP_G) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.F_COMMENT = s.F_COMMENT, t.F_COMMENT2 = s.F_COMMENT2, t.UPDATE_USER = s.UPD_USER, t.UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, t.VERSION = s.VERSION + 1 WHERE nvl(t.VERSION, 0) = s.VERSION WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (EQP_G, F_COMMENT, F_COMMENT2, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, VERSION) VALUES (s.EQP_G, s.F_COMMENT, s.F_COMMENT2, s.UPD_USER, SYSDATE, 1)
